data.one_liner: Tool for creating and running custom Dart lint rules
data.what_it_does: Provides a framework to write, test, and distribute custom lint rules for Dart projects. It includes a CLI, hot‑reload support, and built‑in testing helpers.
use_when: You need project‑specific lint rules not covered by default lints
You want to enforce coding standards across a team or CI
You want to bundle lint rules with a library for consumers
avoid_when: You prefer a lightweight static analysis tool without plugin support
strengths: Easy to write and test lints
Built‑in ignore handling and CI integration
weaknesses: Adds a dev dependency and analysis_options configuration
data.setup_notes: Add custom_lint to dev_dependencies, create analysis_options.yaml with plugins: - custom_lint, optionally configure rules. No build_runner needed.
